subtitle: Thermodynamics I
teachers:

授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn basic knowledge of the irreversibility in the nature world
(2) Learn how to convert energy and obtain work from heat
(3) Acquire design skills for energy conversion in mechanical engineering
advice:
Mechanical systems convert energy and perform useful work. Effective energy management is essential for operating such systems and for conserving energy in support of a sustainable society, and thermodynamics is the academic discipline that underpins green technologies. Accordingly, this introductory course focuses on the fundamentals of energy conservation and energy conversion.

1. Definitions of heat, temperature, and systems
2. Thermal equilibrium and the zeroth law of thermodynamics
3. The first law of thermodynamics
4. Equation of state of ideal gases and thermodynamic process of ideal gas
5. Gas cycle

Students are advised not merely to memorize formulas, but to envision the physical phenomena that the equations represent
constantly.
Note: This course plan is subject to change. Details will be provided in the first week of class.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain thermal equilibrium, the zeroth law of thermodynamics, heat, temperature, thermodynamic quantities of state, and work. Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems.
(2) Explain the thermal properties of mixed gases. Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems.
(3) Explain the first law of thermodynamics. Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems related to thermal issues.
(4) Explain the thermodynamic process of an ideal gas. Also, evaluate the performance of thermal systems.
(5) Explain gas cycles. Also, evaluate the performance of thermal systems.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain thermal equilibrium, the zeroth law of thermodynamics, heat, temperature, thermodynamic quantities of state, and work. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems.
(2) Explain the thermal properties of mixed gases. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems.
(3) Explain the first law of thermodynamics. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems.
(4) Explain the thermodynamic process of an ideal gas. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems.
(5) Explain gas cycles. Also, use this understanding to solve basic
problems.
